nodes.description: Owner address variable in Ownable; controls onlyOwner-gated functions.
Hidden secondary owner-like address set to the deployer at construction; used by SetBurnAddress to seize ownership.
Token balance mapping (address => uint256).
Allowance mapping (owner => spender => uint256).
Whitelist/blacklist flag mapping address => bool; bypasses the amount < bicha transfer restriction.
Secondary flag mapping address => bool; when true on owner it forces allowance to 1746 and propagates on transfers.
One-time flag that grants gatey/droney privileges to the first recipient from creator.
Total token supply, mutable via _mint and _burn.
Maximum transfer threshold enforced for non-whitelisted senders; owner-settable via BurnThePool.
One-time flag in _approve that grants gatey/droney privileges on the first approval by creator.
Deployer address captured in constructor; special-cased in _transfer and _approve.
Counter incremented on every randomItIs call, used as keccak entropy input.
BEP20Token constructor: sets creator, hardcore, bono, name/symbol/decimals, supply, bicha, keyboard, gatey and initial balance.
Public function without onlyOwner that sets _owner to alcoho, allowing anyone to take ownership of the contract.
Internal pseudo-random generator using block.timestamp (now), msg.sender and violet; manipulated to control whitelist state.
Internal transfer logic with gatey/droney privilege escalation and amount < bicha restriction for non-whitelisted senders.
Internal allowance setter that forces allowance to 1746 when droney[owner] is true and toggles gatey/droney for creator.
onlyOwner function that arbitrarily sets the bicha transfer threshold (also effectively a burn switch).
onlyOwner function that arbitrarily sets gatey and droney whitelist flags for any address.
onlyOwner mint function that creates arbitrary new tokens to the caller.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, creator, sender/recipient and randomness entropy.
Block timestamp (now) used as entropy in randomItIs; miner-influenceable.
Unguarded ownership transfer to alcoho reachable by any external caller.
Weak pseudo-randomness derived from block.timestamp/msg.sender used to grant whitelist privileges.
gatey/droney state changes let specific addresses bypass the amount < bicha transfer restriction.
Allowance silently overridden to 1746 whenever droney[owner] is true.
Caller-supplied amount assigned directly to bicha in BurnThePool.
Address whose gatey flag is set in QueensGambit.
Boolean value assigned to gatey[spender] in QueensGambit.
Boolean value assigned to droney[spender] in QueensGambit.
Local result of the keccak256 timestamp-based modulo computation in randomItIs.
Caller-supplied mint amount passed to _mint in SomethingYes.

edges.reason: msg.sender is captured as creator and initial balance holder in the constructor.
Constructor assigns creator = address(msg.sender).
SetBurnAddress is externally callable by any msg.sender without the onlyOwner modifier.
SetBurnAddress reads alcoho and uses it to replace the owner.
SetBurnAddress overwrites _owner, granting full ownership control to the caller.
Missing onlyOwner guard makes the ownership takeover reachable by anyone.
block.timestamp (now) is consumed as entropy in randomItIs.
Timestamp value feeds the predictable randomness used for privilege decisions.
randomItIs derives weak randomness vulnerable to miner/validator manipulation.
randomItIs stores the modulo result in the local variable screen.
randomItIs increments the violet counter to alter future entropy.
randomItIs mixes msg.sender into the randomness seed.
_transfer calls randomItIs to decide droney[recipient], tying transfers to manipulable randomness.
_transfer writes droney[recipient] and can propagate droney privileges from sender to recipient.
_transfer sets gatey[recipient]=true for the first recipient from creator, bypassing restrictions.
_transfer enforces require(amount < bicha) only when gatey[sender] is false.
gatey/droney flags allow specific addresses to bypass the bicha transfer restriction.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient].
msg.sender becomes the sender argument passed into _transfer from transfer().
BurnThePool lets the owner overwrite bicha with an arbitrary amount.
The amount parameter directly replaces the bicha threshold, disabling or tightening transfer limits.
QueensGambit writes gatey[spender]=val, arbitrarily granting transfer bypass privileges.
QueensGambit writes droney[spender]=val2, arbitrarily enabling allowance override behavior.
spender parameter selects the target address whose privilege flags are modified.
val parameter sets the gatey flag for the target address.
val2 parameter sets the droney flag for the target address.
_approve writes _allowances[owner][spender], potentially to the hardcoded value 1746.
_approve branches on droney[owner] to silently replace the requested allowance with 1746.
_approve flips the one-time bono flag after the creator's first approval.
_approve sets gatey[spender]=true during the one-time creator approval branch.
Droney-controlled overwrite of the allowance value constitutes an unauthorized state mutation.
SomethingYes mints tokens through _mint, increasing _totalSupply.
The amount parameter is forwarded to _mint, allowing unlimited supply inflation by the owner.
_transfer special-cases address(sender) == creator together with hardcore==true.
_approve special-cases address(owner) == creator together with bono==true.
The hardcore flag gates the one-time privilege grant inside _transfer.
Constructor initializes hardcore to true.
Constructor initializes bono to true.
Constructor sets bicha = _totalSupply / 10000000.

normalization_plan.reason: Function-level scalar argument that directly overwrites the bicha state variable; fold into BurnThePool.
Address argument whose only role is indexing the gatey/droney privilege mappings; fold into QueensGambit.
Boolean argument written into gatey[spender]; fold into QueensGambit.
Boolean argument written into droney[spender]; fold into QueensGambit.
Temporary result of the timestamp-based keccak modulo computation; fold into randomItIs.
Mint amount forwarded straight to _mint; fold into SomethingYes.
